Phenotype A (lower burden).description: Lower symptom burden across all domains (vasomotor, psychological, somatic, sleep).

Phenotype B (higher, multi-domain burden.description: Elevated symptom burden across all domains simultaneously, not one dominant domain; skews toward later menopausal stages.

Atypical / mixed profile.description: Flagged by consensus anomaly detection (Isolation Forest + LOF); reflects high multi-domain variance.
